content.line: I set it up, host it for you, and tune it for 30 days. Your data stays yours, and if you ever want to run it yourself, I hand it all over.

content.line1: Anyone can vibe-code an app these days.
content.line2: Here's why you'd still hire me.
content.body: You could build this yourself with AI, and the first version would probably work. The hard part is knowing it still works next month, on a slow phone, after an update nobody noticed. So nothing I build goes live until it passes the checks a big software team would run. I can't skip them either.
